questions.question: Two trains 259 m and 431 m long are running in opposite directions at a speed of 52 km/h and 56 km/h, respectively. They cross each other in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed (Opposite directions) = 52 + 56 = 108 km/h

Relative Speed in m/s = 108 × (5 ÷ 18) = 30 m/s

Total Distance to cross = 259 + 431 = 690 m

Time = 690 ÷ 30 = 23 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 23 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Opposite Directions Crossing

 Relative Speed = 52 + 56 = 108 km/h

**Given:**

Length of 1st train (L₁) = 259 m

Speed of 1st train (S₁) = 52 km/h

Length of 2ⁿd train (L₂) = 431 m

Speed of 2ⁿd train (S₂) = 56 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed for opposite directions = S₁ + S₂

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Convert km/h to m/s by multiplying with (5 ÷ 18)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = L₁ + L₂

⇒ Total Distance = 259 + 431 = 690 m

⇒ Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂

⇒ Relative Speed = 52 + 56 = 108 km/h

⇒ Convert speed to m/s = 108 × (5 ÷ 18) = 30 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 690 ÷ 30

⇒ Time taken = 23 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 23 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects move towards each other (in opposite directions), their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: SR = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds: SR = |S₁ − S₂|.

Distance While Crossing

When two trains cross each other, the total distance covered is always equal to the sum of their lengths, regardless of the direction of their movement.

Unit Conversion Rule

To convert a speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5 ÷ 18. Conversely, to convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, one candidate secured 42% of the votes and was defeated by the other candidate with a margin of 416 votes. If all the votes cast were valid, what was the total number of votes polled?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Loser = 42% ⇒ Winner = 58%

Margin = 58% − 42% = 16%

16% corresponds to 416 votes

Total votes = 416 ÷ 0.16

**∴ Answer = 2600**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One candidate = 42%, margin = 416 votes

**Formula used:**

Margin% = Difference in vote percentages

**Calculation:**

⇒ Winner's percentage = 100 − 42 = 58%

⇒ Margin% = 58 − 42 = 16%

⇒ 16% of total votes = 416

⇒ Total votes = (416 × 100) ÷ 16

⇒ = 2600

**∴ The correct answer is 2600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Margin

Margin = Difference between winner% and loser%

Percentage Conversion

Total = (given value × 100) ÷ percentage

Complement Rule

If one gets x%, other gets (100 − x)%

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 40%, 25% and 45% in three successive months, but increases by 55% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take initial price = 100

After 40% decrease ⇒ 60

After 25% decrease ⇒ 60 × 0.75 = 45

After 45% decrease ⇒ 45 × 0.55 = 24.75

**∴ After 55% increase ⇒ 24.75 × 1.55 = 38.36 ⇒ decrease = 61.64%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −40%, −25%, −45%, +55%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × successive multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Assume initial price = 100

⇒ After 40% decrease: 100 × 0.60 = 60

⇒ After 25% decrease: 60 × 0.75 = 45

⇒ After 45% decrease: 45 × 0.55 = 24.75

⇒ After 55% increase: 24.75 × 1.55 = 38.3625

⇒ Net change = 38.3625 − 100 = −61.6375

⇒ Percentage change = −61.64%

**∴ The price decreases by 61.64%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Use multipliers: (1 ± rate/100) for each step

Net Effect

Final value compared with original gives overall % change

Base Method

Assume initial value = 100 for easier calculation

questions.question:
Which of the following numbers is divisible by both 6 and 9, but not divisible by 12?

126, 252, 72, 108
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number divisible by both 6 and 9 must be divisible by their LCM, which is 18.

We simply need to find a multiple of 18 from the options that is NOT a multiple of 12.

⇒ 108 ÷ 12 = 9 (Divisible)

⇒ 126 ÷ 12 = 10.5 (Not divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 126.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers to check: 126, 252, 72, 108

Condition: The number should be divisible by 6 and 9, but leave a remainder when divided by 12.

**Rules used:**

⇒ Divisibility by 6: The number must be even and divisible by 3.

⇒ Divisibility by 9: The sum of the digits must be divisible by 9.

⇒ Divisibility by 12: The number must be divisible by both 3 and 4 (last two digits divisible by 4).

**Calculations:**

⇒ For 108: Sum of digits = 9. Last two digits '08' are divisible by 4. Thus, it is divisible by 6, 9, and 12.

⇒ For 126: Sum of digits = 9. Last two digits '26' are NOT divisible by 4. Thus, it is divisible by 6 and 9, but not by 12.

⇒ For 72: Sum of digits = 9. Last two digits '72' are divisible by 4. Thus, it is divisible by 6, 9, and 12.

⇒ For 252: Sum of digits = 9. Last two digits '52' are divisible by 4. Thus, it is divisible by 6, 9, and 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 126.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 & 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3 or 9 respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 & 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits are divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8.

Divisibility by Co-primes

If a number is divisible by two co-prime numbers, it must also be divisible by their product (e.g., being divisible by 3 and 4 individually means the number is divisible by 12).

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 15 and 10 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM of 3, 15, and 10 = 30 units

Total efficiency (A + B + C) = (30 ÷ 3) + (30 ÷ 15) + (30 ÷ 10) = 10 + 2 + 3 = 15 units/day

Target work = 2 × Total Work = 2 × 30 = 60 units

Combined time taken = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 15 days

Time taken by C = 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 3
 30
 10
 
 

 B
 15
 2
 
 

 C
 10
 3
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of A, B, and C together = 10 + 2 + 3 = 15 units/day.

⇒ Let the initial total work be 30 units.

⇒ New work required (twice the same work) = 2 × 30 = 60 units.

⇒ Time taken together = New work ÷ Total efficiency

⇒ Time taken together = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Works exactly like Time & Work. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency (filling) and outlet pipes have negative efficiency (emptying).

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the exact ratio of the work done by each person. If people work for the same number of days, wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Days Work

When two people work on alternate days, find the combined work done in a "cycle" of 2 days, multiply the cycle close to total work, and then assign the remaining work to the first person.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,000 at 5% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of compound interest for 2 years at 5% = 5 + 5 + (5 × 5)/100 = 10.25%

Total amount percentage after 2 years = 100% (Principal) + 10.25% (Interest) = 110.25%

Amount = 110.25% of 2000

Amount = 1.1025 × 2000 = 2205

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2205.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per annum

Time Period (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

questions.question: Saloni's age is 7 years more than twice her sister Emma's age. If the sum of their ages is 25 years, how old is Emma?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Emma = x

Saloni = 2x + 7

Total = x + (2x + 7) = 25

⇒ 3x + 7 = 25 ⇒ x = 6

**∴ Emma's age = 6 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Saloni = 2 × Emma + 7, Total age = 25

**Formula used:**

Form linear equation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Emma's age = x

⇒ Saloni's age = 2x + 7

⇒ x + (2x + 7) = 25

⇒ 3x + 7 = 25

⇒ 3x = 18

⇒ x = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation

questions.question: The prices of articles P, Q and R are ₹280, ₹180 and ₹100, respectively. Subrata buys these articles in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5, spending a total of ₹26,780. How many articles of type Q did he buy?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let quantities = 3x, 4x, 5x

Total cost = 280×3x + 180×4x + 100×5x

= (840 + 720 + 500)x = 2060x

2060x = 26780 ⇒ x = 13

**∴ Q items = 4x = 52**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Prices: P = 280, Q = 180, R = 100

Ratio of quantities = 3 : 4 : 5, Total cost = 26780

**Formula used:**

Total cost = sum of (price × quantity)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let quantities be 3x, 4x, 5x

⇒ Total cost = 280×3x + 180×4x + 100×5x

⇒ = 840x + 720x + 500x

⇒ = 2060x

⇒ 2060x = 26780

⇒ x = 13

⇒ Quantity of Q = 4x = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method

Let quantities be multiples of a common variable

questions.question: Simplify ((3²)⁶)⁵ and express it as a power of 9. What is the exponent of 9?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

((3²)⁶)⁵ ⇒ multiply powers

= 3²×⁶×⁵ = 3⁶⁰

Now 9 = 3²

⇒ 3⁶⁰ = (3²)³⁰ = 9³⁰

**∴ Exponent = 30**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((3²)⁶)⁵

**Concept Used:**

Laws of exponents

**Calculation:**

⇒ (3²)⁶ = 3¹²

⇒ (3¹²)⁵ = 3⁶⁰

⇒ 9 = 3²

⇒ 3⁶⁰ = (3²)³⁰ = 9³⁰

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Power Rule

(am)ⁿ = amⁿ

Base Conversion

Express numbers in same base to compare powers

Exponent Simplification

Multiply exponents when powers are raised again

questions.question: The total cost of 10 mangoes and 13 apples is ₹134 and the cost of 4 apples is ₹13 less than that of 15 mangoes. Then find the price (in rupees) of a mango and an apple, respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let mango = m, apple = a

10m + 13a = 134 and 4a = 15m − 13

Try m = 4 ⇒ 15m − 13 = 60 − 13 = 47 ⇒ 4a = 47 (not integer)

Try m = 3 ⇒ 45 − 13 = 32 ⇒ a = 8

**∴ Mango = 3, Apple = 8**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10m + 13a = 134

4a = 15m − 13

**Formula used:**

Solving linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ From second equation: 4a = 15m − 13

⇒ a = (15m − 13)/4

⇒ Substitute in first equation:

⇒ 10m + 13[(15m − 13)/4] = 134

⇒ Multiply by 4:

⇒ 40m + 195m − 169 = 536

⇒ 235m = 705

⇒ m = 3

⇒ a = (45 − 13)/4 = 32/4 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3 and ₹8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations

Use substitution or elimination to solve equations

Trial Method

Try small integer values for quick solution

Substitution Method

Express one variable and substitute into another equation

questions.question: {Find the value of } frac{sin 30circ + cos 60circ}{cot 45circ} .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly substitute the standard trigonometric values:

sin 30° = 1/2, cos 60° = 1/2, and cot 45° = 1

Expression = (1/2 + 1/2) ÷ 1

Expression = 1 ÷ 1 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The trigonometric expression is (sin 30° + cos 60°) ÷ cot 45°

**Values Used:**

⇒ sin 30° = 1/2

⇒ cos 60° = 1/2

⇒ cot 45° = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ Substitute the standard values into the given expression:

⇒ Expression = (1/2 + 1/2) ÷ 1

⇒ Expression = ((1 + 1) / 2) ÷ 1

⇒ Expression = (2 / 2) ÷ 1

⇒ Expression = 1 ÷ 1

⇒ Expression = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles

In trigonometry, sine and cosine are co-functions. This means sin θ = cos(90° − θ). Therefore, sin 30° = cos(90° − 30°) = cos 60°.

Reciprocal Identities

Cotangent is the reciprocal of tangent. cot θ = 1 ÷ tan θ. Since tan 45° = 1, cot 45° is also 1 ÷ 1 = 1.

Common Trigonometric Values

sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2 | sin 60° = √3/2, cos 60° = 1/2 | tan 45° = 1, cot 45° = 1.

questions.question: The average of 8 numbers is 121. If the first 7 numbers are 35, 35, 49, 83, 102, 80 and 20, then the eighth number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum = 8 × 121 = 968

Sum of given 7 numbers = 35 + 35 + 49 + 83 + 102 + 80 + 20 = 404

Missing number = 968 − 404

= 564

**∴ Answer = 564**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 8 numbers = 121

First 7 numbers = 35, 35, 49, 83, 102, 80, 20

**Formula used:**

Sum = Average × Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sum = 8 × 121 = 968

⇒ Sum of 7 numbers = 35 + 35 + 49 + 83 + 102 + 80 + 20

⇒ = 404

⇒ 8th number = 968 − 404 = 564

**∴ The correct answer is 564.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of terms

Missing Value

Missing number = Total sum − sum of known values

Quick Calculation

Multiply average directly to get total

questions.question: The salaries of X, Y and Z are in the ratio 4:18:21. If the increments of 90%, 90% and 40% are allowed, respectively, in their salaries, then what will be the new ratio of their salaries?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Original ratio = 4 : 18 : 21

Apply multipliers ⇒ 1.9, 1.9, 1.4

New ratio = 4×1.9 : 18×1.9 : 21×1.4

= 7.6 : 34.2 : 29.4 ⇒ multiply by 5

**∴ Answer = 38 : 171 : 147**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio = 4 : 18 : 21

Increments = 90%, 90%, 40%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 + increase/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ X = 4 × 1.9 = 7.6

⇒ Y = 18 × 1.9 = 34.2

⇒ Z = 21 × 1.4 = 29.4

⇒ Ratio = 7.6 : 34.2 : 29.4

⇒ Multiply by 5 ⇒ 38 : 171 : 147

**∴ The correct answer is 38 : 171 : 147.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase

New = Old × (1 + rate/100)

Ratio Scaling

Multiply all terms to remove decimals

Simplification

Reduce ratio to simplest integer form

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 35, 53, 38, 89, 71, 69, 86, 40 and 41 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take assumed mean = 60

Deviations: −25, −7, −22, +29, +11, +9, +26, −20, −19

Sum of deviations = −18

Mean = 60 + (−18/9)

**∴ Answer = 58**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 35, 53, 38, 89, 71, 69, 86, 40, 41

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Sum of observations) ÷ Number of observations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum = 35 + 53 + 38 + 89 + 71 + 69 + 86 + 40 + 41

⇒ = 522

⇒ Number of observations = 9

⇒ Mean = 522 ÷ 9 = 58

**∴ The correct answer is 58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

Mean = Total sum ÷ number of values

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following four schemes:

A) Two successive discounts of 39% and 8%

B) Buy 8, get 4 free

C) A single discount of 16%

D) Two successive discounts of 38% and 34%

Which scheme is best for the shopkeeper?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find effective discount for each scheme

A ⇒ 39 + 8 − (39×8/100) = 47 − 3.12 = 43.88%

B ⇒ Buy 8 get 4 ⇒ discount = 4/12 × 100 = 33.33%

C ⇒ 16%

D ⇒ 38 + 34 − (38×34/100) = 72 − 12.92 = 59.08%

**∴ Best for shopkeeper = C (least discount)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Four discount schemes A, B, C, D

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = a + b − (ab/100), Buy X get Y ⇒ Y/(X+Y) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ A: 39 + 8 − (39×8/100) = 43.88%

⇒ B: 4/(8+4) × 100 = 33.33%

⇒ C: 16%

⇒ D: 38 + 34 − (38×34/100) = 59.08%

⇒ Compare discounts: 16 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net = a + b − (ab/100)

Buy X Get Y

Discount = Y/(X+Y) × 100

Key Insight

Shopkeeper prefers minimum discount (maximum profit)

questions.question: Two pipes can fill a cistern, individually, in 96 min and 64 min, respectively. There is a pipe located at the bottom of the cistern to empty it. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, then the empty cistern gets filled in 48 min. How long will the pipe at the bottom of the tank take to empty the completely filled cistern if no other pipe is then open?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of cistern = LCM of 96, 64, and 48 = 192 units.

Efficiency of the two filling pipes = 192 ÷ 96 = +2 units/min, and 192 ÷ 64 = +3 units/min.

Combined efficiency of all three pipes = 192 ÷ 48 = +4 units/min.

Efficiency of the emptying pipe = 4 − (2 + 3) = −1 unit/min.

**∴ The correct answer is 192 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A to fill the cistern = 96 min

Time taken by Pipe B to fill the cistern = 64 min

Time taken when all three pipes (A, B, and emptying Pipe C) are open = 48 min

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Time × Efficiency

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Time (min)**
 **Total Work (Units)**
 **Efficiency (Units/min)**
 
 

 Pipe A (Fill)
 96
 192
 +2
 
 

 Pipe B (Fill)
 64
 +3
 
 

 A + B + C
 48
 +4
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of the emptying Pipe C be −x units/min.

⇒ Combined efficiency = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B − Efficiency of C

⇒ 4 = 2 + 3 − x

⇒ x = 5 − 4 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Time taken by Pipe C to empty the completely filled cistern = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of Pipe C

⇒ Time = 192 ÷ 1 = 192 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 192 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Concept

If a pipe fills a tank in x hours, its efficiency is +1/x per hour. If it empties the tank in y hours, its efficiency is −1/y per hour.

Work and Wages

Wages are strictly distributed in direct proportion to the amount of work done, which corresponds to the ratio of their efficiency if they work for the same duration.

Alternate Days Working

When individuals work on alternate days, calculate the total work done in one complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 workers) to approach the total capacity before adding individual days.

questions.question: In a quadrilateral MNST, ∠M = 63° and ∠N = 99°. The bisectors of ∠S and ∠T meet at O. What is the measure of ∠TOS?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of any two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is half the sum of the remaining two angles.

∠TOS = (∠M + ∠N) ÷ 2

∠TOS = (63° + 99°) ÷ 2

∠TOS = 162° ÷ 2 = 81°

**∴ The correct answer is 81°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠M = 63°

∠N = 99°

O is the point of intersection of the angle bisectors of ∠S and ∠T.

 
 
• 
• M N S T O 
 63° 
 99° 
 ? 

**Calculations:**

We know that the sum of all interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°.

⇒ ∠M + ∠N + ∠S + ∠T = 360°

⇒ 63° + 99° + ∠S + ∠T = 360°

⇒ 162° + ∠S + ∠T = 360°

⇒ ∠S + ∠T = 360° − 162° = 198°

In ΔTOS, the sum of the angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠TOS + ∠OST + ∠OTS = 180°

Since SO and TO are the angle bisectors of ∠S and ∠T respectively:

⇒ ∠OST = ∠S ÷ 2

⇒ ∠OTS = ∠T ÷ 2

Substituting these values into the triangle's angle sum equation:

⇒ ∠TOS + (∠S ÷ 2) + (∠T ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠TOS + (∠S + ∠T) ÷ 2 = 180°

⇒ ∠TOS + 198° ÷ 2 = 180°

⇒ ∠TOS + 99° = 180°

⇒ ∠TOS = 180° − 99° = 81°

**∴ The correct answer is 81°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Bisectors of a Quadrilateral

The angle formed by the intersection of the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is always equal to half the sum of the other two non-adjacent interior angles.

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of interior angles of any n-sided polygon is given by the formula: (n − 2) × 180°. For a standard quadrilateral (n = 4), the sum of all four angles is exactly 360°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

If all four vertices of a quadrilateral lie perfectly on the circumference of a circle, it is called a cyclic quadrilateral. In this special case, the sum of opposite interior angles is always strictly 180°.

questions.question: What is the least number which should be added to 539, so that the number obtained is exactly divisible by 10, 15 and 3?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 10, 15, 3 = 30

Find next multiple of 30 after 539

540 is divisible by 30

Required addition = 540 − 539

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 539, divisors = 10, 15, 3

**Formula used:**

Required number = Next multiple of LCM − given number

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 10, 15, 3 = 30

⇒ 539 ÷ 30 = 17 remainder 29

⇒ Next multiple = 18 × 30 = 540

⇒ Required addition = 540 − 539 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Concept

LCM gives smallest number divisible by all given numbers

Remainder Method

Subtract remainder from divisor to get required addition

Divisibility

Number must be exact multiple of LCM

questions.question: A park, in the shape of a quadrilateral ABCD, has ∠C = 90°, AB = 36 m, BC = 42 m, CD = 40 m and AD = 36 m. What is the area (in m², rounded off to 1 decimal place) of the park?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Split quadrilateral along BD

Triangle BCD is right-angled → Area = (1/2)×42×40 = 840

Find BD using Pythagoras: BD = √(42² + 40²) = √3364 = 58

Triangle ABD has sides 36, 36, 58 → use Heron’s formula

s = (36 + 36 + 58)/2 = 65

Area = √[65×29×29×7] ≈ 618.5

Total area = 840 + 618.5 = 1458.5

**∴ Answer = 1458.5 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

AB = 36, BC = 42, CD = 40, AD = 36, ∠C = 90°

**Formula used:**

Area of right triangle = (1/2)ab, Heron’s formula

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebbc0111a36e3f9939c680df6067d7aaa78eacc5d9811b0eb46b079333d90a48.png] 

⇒ Area of ΔBCD = (1/2)×42×40 = 840

⇒ BD = √(42² + 40²) = 58

⇒ ΔABD with sides 36, 36, 58

⇒ s = 65

⇒ Area = √[65×(65−36)×(65−36)×(65−58)]

⇒ = √[65×29×29×7] ≈ 618.5

⇒ Total area = 840 + 618.5 = 1458.5

**∴ The correct answer is 1458.5 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divide Complex Shape

Split quadrilateral into triangles.

Pythagoras Theorem

Used to find diagonal in right triangle.

Heron’s Formula

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

Accuracy

Round final answer to required decimal places.

questions.question: A man has to cover a distance of 168 km in 18 hours. If he covers two-thirds of this distance in (2)/(6) of the time, then what should be his speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place) to cover the remaining distance in the time left ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 168 km, total time = 18 hr

Covered distance = (2/3)×168 = 112 km

Time taken = (2/6)×18 = 6 hr

Remaining distance = 168 − 112 = 56 km

Remaining time = 18 − 6 = 12 hr

Required speed = 56 ÷ 12 = 4.67 ≈ 4.7 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 4.7 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 168 km, Total time = 18 hr

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered = (2/3) × 168 = 112 km

⇒ Time taken = (2/6) × 18 = 6 hr

⇒ Remaining distance = 168 − 112 = 56 km

⇒ Remaining time = 18 − 6 = 12 hr

⇒ Speed = 56 ÷ 12 = 4.67 ≈ 4.7 km/hr

**∴ The required speed is 4.7 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Fraction Handling

Convert fractions carefully before calculation.

Remaining Values

Subtract from total to find remaining distance/time.

Rounding Rule

Round to one decimal place as required.

questions.question: In a test, B got 50 marks while A got 75 marks, out of 120 maximum marks. What percentage of A's marks was B's marks? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)

= (50 / 75) × 100

questions.question:
If a solid sphere of radius 14 cm is moulded into 8 spherical solid balls of equal radius, then find the surface area of each ball.

 ({Use } pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved ⇒ R³ = 8r³ ⇒ r = R/2 = 7 cm

Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 7²

= 4 × (22/7) × 49 = 616 cm²

**∴ Answer = 616 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of big sphere = 14 cm, number of small spheres = 8

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³, Surface area = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume conserved:

(4/3)π(14)³ = 8 × (4/3)πr³

⇒ 14³ = 8r³

⇒ r³ = 14³ / 8 = (14/2)³ = 7³

⇒ r = 7 cm

⇒ Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 49

⇒ = 616 cm²

**∴ The surface area of each ball is 616 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

When reshaped, total volume remains same.

Scaling Rule

If number of spheres = n, radius scales as R / n¹/³.

Surface Area

4πr²

π Value

Use 22/7 as given.

questions.question: Given a + b + c = 15 and a² + b² + c² = 83 , find ab + bc + ca .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

15² = 83 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

225 = 83 + 2x

2x = 142 ⇒ x = 71

**∴ Answer = 71**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a + b + c = 15, a² + b² + c² = 83

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (15)² = 83 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 225 = 83 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 225 − 83 = 142

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 142 ÷ 2 = 71

**∴ The correct answer is 71.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Key Idea

Use identity to relate sum and squares

Shortcut Insight

Always square the sum when cross terms are needed

questions.question: A person sells an article for ₹3,450 and earns a profit of 15%. Find the cost price of the article.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

15% Profit = 15/100 = 3/20

Ratio of CP : SP = 20 : (20 + 3) = 20 : 23

Given, 23 units = ₹3,450

1 unit = 3450 ÷ 23 = ₹150

CP = 20 units = 20 × 150 = ₹3,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹3,450

Profit = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 + Profit%]

 
 CP = 100%

 
 SP = 115%

 SP = ₹3450
 
• 

 CP = ?
 
• 

 
• 
 

 + 15% Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP = [3450 × 100] ÷ [100 + 15]

⇒ CP = 345000 ÷ 115

⇒ CP = 3000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Loss Scenario

When an article is sold at a loss, the Selling Price is less than the Cost Price. Formula: CP = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 − Loss%].

Marked Price and Discount

The Marked Price (MP) is set above the Cost Price. Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price: SP = MP − Discount.

Dishonest Dealer Profit

If a dealer sells at cost price but uses a false weight, Profit% = [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100.
